reviews.title: Poor customer service regarding lost baggage.
reviews.text: An otherwise great trip was let down by two baggage handling errors (one each way on a return journey). That's right, my baggage was misplaced on both legs. Although this is becoming common place in flights the communication to get my bag back was appalling. On the first journey the staff were dismissive and would not allow me to contact the baggage courier, nor did they make me feel that my concerns were listened to and that my new contact number had been given to the courier to contact me about appropriate delivery times (I never was contacted). This resulted in less sight seeing as I had to wait around to take delivery of the bag. The bag did turn up 60 hours later. The second flight was worse, but to be fair it was soon after mass flight cancellations (due to weather) so the system was in chaos (and occurred over public holidays). And all though the airline successfully put me on a train to replace the journey they refused to give me my bag, although it was confirmed as being onsite, instead opting to send it to a city once I registered the 'lost' bag online. I eventually got my bag (60 hours later) after many calls, multiple unsuccessful attempts at registering online and then to be told I had to return to an international airport to lodge the lost bag in person. Although the bag was returned to me sooner than I expected by a clever and thoughtful staff member (before I ever was able to register it successfully as lost). The stress caused results in the low review score.
reviews.author: algreary

reviews.title: Lost Luggage
reviews.text: Pilot advised the airport was struggling and did not have enough staff to load the plane. Promised it would be on the next flight to Budapest. 8 days later I still haven't seen my luggage. Disgusting airline. will never fly them again
reviews.author: Pikake

reviews.title: Worse customer service I have ever experiences in my life
reviews.text: Flights were cancelled out of Munich due to weather. Fair enough, not the airlines fault but their handling of it was abysmal. Kept saying they were rebooking flights then re cancelling them. Again I had some sympathy but the communication about what was going on was non existent. Finally managed to sort ourselves out by driving 400km to another airport and booking our own flights. We had no luggage as they had told us to check it in for the cancelled flight. Couldn’t report 5he missing luggage online as the system refused to accept the report saying I had to contact their so called Service Center. The Service Center said they could do nothing without an online report which was not possible. They suggested contacting the Baggage Claim department which I did. They said file a report online and I told them the system was not allowing it. They said they would file a report at their end and send me the reference number. They never did and when I called back the next day to check they had no record of my first call and said they couldn’t file a report for me. They said contacting the Service Center was the only option available which put me back in the never ending loop again. At one point they even told me I had to physically go to the Service Center in Munich even though I was in the Uk!? In short no one in any department in Lufthansa can do anything about anything and don’t seem to care. They are rude and totally unhelpful. Will never ever fly with them again and will be advising every single person I know not to.
reviews.author: Michael J

reviews.title: Aircraft changed and seats reassigned without legroom
reviews.text: Lufthansa advised the aircraft was changed and we had seats beside each other (aisle and middle) though NOT with the paid for extra legroom seats. We weren't the only ones inconvenienced and for a 10+ hour flight we found it unacceptable. Our expectation is to have at least 50% of what our extra legroom cost was ($350.00 CDN refunded in cash, NOT a flight voucher or credit). Food was terrible and lacking as vegetarian option only available for the majority of passengers. Lufthansa's complaint emails not functioning which is ridiculous. I've tried three different computers to connect with Lufthansa and neither of the two emails work.
reviews.author: Robert S

reviews.title: 100% Consistent - Late
reviews.text: Wow, I haven’t the energy to detail the long list of issues with Lufthansa’s very poor service on our journey, but to summarise. 4 flights - DUB to FRA, FRA to BUD, BUD to FRA & FRA to DUB - All flights late ranging from an hour to two hours. Ground crew on the check in desks would be better suited to be working in the prison service shouting orders in a very rude, arrogant and threatening manner. Became hard to listen anything they said by the end of it. On a plus note the cabin crew were very professional, polite and very helpful too. I was extremely shocked how poor flying with Lufthansa is, makes flying with Ryanair look like a private jet service. It so nice to be home and not being spoken to like a piece of dirt anymore by Lufthansa staff.
reviews.author: Nck C

reviews.title: Run away from Lufthansa!
reviews.text: We are very unhappy past Lufthansa customers, and after almost 13 months of unsuccessful message exchanges and communications with the various Customer Service departments including asking for help from the US DOT - Do yourself a favor don't even consider Lufthansa, it's a black hole! We flew with Lufthansa on June 3d, 2022 from O'Hare to the Tel Aviv with a few hours stop in Frankfurt, Germany. Three of our checked bags were lost for over 9 days forcing us to buy few items, the cost of which are officially covered by the standard Airlines policies for the lost luggage. We provided Lufthansa with all the necessary information several times, but the company's Service Departments and mangers are totally ignoring our plea. On Jan 19, 2023, we received the last communication from the Lufthansa Customer Service asking for our bank information without providing any identifying information and/or the payment arrangement details and again, when we responded asking for clarifications, nobody replied. Today July 2023 - We did not receive a penny!
reviews.author: Ela M

reviews.title: Worth customer service
reviews.text: WORTH CUSTOMERS SERVICE! Lufthansa canceled a connection flight along WITH MY DAUGHTER’s TICKET!? Fully confirmed, with $800 seats upgrade. Their solution - buy new tickets. last time with Lufthansa. Stay away
reviews.author: FunTravel4All

reviews.title: Rediculous leg space and misleading information
reviews.text: Like the title says, the leg space is rediculous and they don't actually let you select a seat even though they advertise "Economy" as a plan where this is possible. I'd avoid flying with Lufthansa whenever possible.
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.title: Cancelation and leaving for 24 hours without any accommodation in airport
reviews.text: I recently had the unfortunate experience of flying with Lufthansa from Vancouver to Frankfurt, and I must say it was an absolute nightmare. From start to finish, the airline demonstrated a complete lack of professionalism and disregard for their customers. I encountered numerous issues that left me thoroughly disappointed and frustrated. To begin with, the flight schedule was changed not once or twice, but a staggering six times. It was incredibly inconvenient and disrupted my entire travel plans. Eventually, the flight was canceled, citing what I believe was a flimsy excuse of excessive snowfall. While the snowfall may have been considered significant by Lufthansa's standards, it was nothing out of the ordinary for the region. Their lack of preparation and adaptability was highly disappointing. Furthermore, the customer service provided by Lufthansa was abysmal. There was a complete absence of apologies or attempts to rectify the situation. Instead of promptly notifying passengers of the changes or offering alternative solutions, they displayed a shocking level of incompetence. They seemed completely unaware of proper customer service protocols, such as arranging taxis or providing accommodations for stranded passengers. This lack of knowledge and disregard for passengers' well-being was both disheartening and frustrating. In addition, the airline failed to meet even the basic needs of their customers. They did not provide appropriate food options for passengers, leaving many of us hungry and unsatisfied. Moreover, Lufthansa blatantly refused to follow international rules and regulations by not arranging alternative flights for their stranded customers. This lack of cooperation and refusal to assist passengers in finding suitable alternatives further highlighted their poor customer service. The sympathy and compassion displayed by Lufthansa workers were nonexistent. The staff members were rude, unhelpful, and seemed more interested in sitting through strikes than attending to passengers' needs. It was a clear indication that they lacked empathy and failed to prioritize customer satisfaction. Furthermore, Lufthansa showed a complete disregard for their customers' time and effort. They demonstrated a lack of appreciation for the money paid by passengers, charging more than the average fare for subpar services. It was disappointing to see an airline of their stature not valuing their customers and prioritizing profit over customer satisfaction. The lack of basic amenities was also evident during the flight. Despite the freezing temperatures onboard, Lufthansa did not provide free blankets, leaving passengers shivering throughout the journey. Additionally, they failed to offer complimentary earphones for in-flight entertainment, forcing customers to either bring their own or go without. These small yet significant details contribute to the overall experience and reflect poorly on the airline's commitment to passenger comfort. Furthermore, Lufthansa's questionable financial practices were alarming. They borrowed money from customers, but failed to repay it for an extended period of over a year. This unprofessional behavior demonstrates a lack of integrity and raises serious concerns about their financial management. Lastly, the seating arrangement on the flight was far from satisfactory. Lufthansa had squeezed in additional seats to maximize capacity, resulting in cramped and uncomfortable conditions for passengers. It was evident that their priority was to accommodate as many customers as possible, without considering the comfort of those onboard. In conclusion, my experience with Lufthansa on the Vancouver to Frankfurt flight was highly disappointing. The airline demonstrated a complete disregard for their customers' time, effort, and comfort. The constant changes in flight schedule, lack of customer service, and failure to meet basic needs were all indicative of their poor service quality. I would strongly advise against choos
reviews.author: Reza

reviews.title: Awful customer service from a horrible airline
reviews.text: Shady, dishonest customer service. Anyone who flies regularly knows bulkhead seats are generally less legroom than the regular seats. I even requested to be moved from first class on a U.S. flight to premium because the bulkhead killed the room I had to stretch my leg. Anyway, I paid an extra $125 for a seat I confirmed with customer service was "extra legroom." I asked multiple times to confirm this was a bulkhead seat with extra legroom and I was told yes, so I paid the extra amount. When I got on the plane, I come to find out that they lied to me, which I confirmed by stretching my legs in the non-bulkhead seat behind me. I requested a refund which I regularly followed up on, and trusted that they would look into. In hindsight I am an idiot for not contesting this with my credit card immediately. I got the run around for months with no resolve, saying they were working on it. At this point, with multiple follow up emails and calls, I don't even hear from them anymore. This airline is terrible with horrible customer service. Do not fly on this scummy airline if you don't want to be ripped off. If you have the option to fly another airline, please do. If something happens that requires a refund, they will pretend they are investigating, then stop responding to you once outside of the window you can contest the charge with your credit card company.
reviews.author: forsterm2018

reviews.title: Worst airline ever!
reviews.text: DO NOT FLY this airline! Spent a lot on business class to only be treated like trash. Canceled flights and zero compensation. Horrible customer service and just a complete let down. Save your money or buy another ticket from another airline. They suck!!
reviews.author: Kali

reviews.title: Left us stranded told us to find out own way home
reviews.text: we could not land to Munich on June 23 because of a thunderstorm. We were diverted to Milan after flying in a circle pattern for some time for refueling. After refueling, the Lufthansa crew decided they wanted to go home so they cancelled the flight and left 300 passengers stranded at the Milan airport. We all stood in line all night at the airport just to get a hotel. There were two people helping with this and one taxi driver. The Italian contractors who work for Lufthansa upstairs at the ticket counter were nasty. They would not help any of the passengers get rebooked with their tickets, the managers showed up at 6am, told us all in english that we were on our own, to buy our own tickets that he was not a magician. These were passengers from Germany, Sweden, United States. The agents were so Nasty, they brought 20-30 passengers ahead of us and told us that these passengers had priority and to go to the other line. I will never fly Lufthansa ever again. We ended up buying an additional one way ticket to the United States for $3200, Munich was not our final destination. A british man was going all the way to Bangkok, he couldn't even purchase a ticket because they were all ready overbooked. The value office was responsible for getting us a hotel, they put us in one an hour away. We almost missed our flight the next day because the transport didn't come early enough, we got the last two seats on the plane. Of course, we our disputing all charges with our bank. I am shocked at the behavior of the Italians, the outright coldness and unprofessionalism. I even tried to ask a question in the airport to two Italian women who were standing in the airport in uniform and before I could even say anything, she blasted me and said - can't you see that I am having a coffee - that I am not information. Her boss was standing right there, he said nothing. Her mouth was as big as her head, nasty. I stood there at that Lufthansa counter and watched those Italian agents yell at all those displaced passengers and shoo them away, how disgraceful, they should be FIRED!!!! It will be the last time i travel to Italy also. Americans are not treated very well in Italy, don't go there, not unless you are George Clooney of course.
reviews.author: marsha w

reviews.title: AWFUL!
reviews.text: I am a frequent traveler and will never fly Lufthansa again. From the disorganization of boarding, to the delayed flights, changing our return flight constantly during our trip to loosing our luggage upon our return. This was due to them changing our return flight and giving us mere minutes to make connection, which obviously wasn’t enough to time to transfer our bags. I’ve only flown them once before, but since then they seem to have forgotten how to do their jobs. From ticket agents, to flight attendants and ground crew (took 15 mins for them to bring stairs to on time flight) they were awful. Oh! And also had the worst landing of any flight I’ve ever been on with the pilot slamming the plane to the tarmac. I’m actually amazed by how every single thing about both our inbound and outbound flights sucked!
reviews.author: Fienneone

reviews.title: Worst Airline - 0 for customer support
reviews.text: Really bad experience interacting with customer support on 18001025838 . It took almost 50 calls to get connected with their customer support
reviews.author: mayank

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight from Berlin to Frankfurt so I can fly to Tunis from there and forced me to take another flight to Munich to sleep over there and take the flight to Tunis the next day. They said that was “the best option” and don’t get me started on that Service Center they have in Munich. The waiting time is +1h in a queue. They charge you for +600€ for the trip, they cancel the flights and change your itinerary as they wish, and once you are on board, they don’t even offer good beverages and food during the flight, you have to pay for it. Definitely I won’t consider Lufthansa as my first option to travel from now on.
reviews.author: CH.M

reviews.title: Damaged or lost luggage every time
reviews.text: The staff on the actual plane is very nice. But the workers who handle the luggage don’t give a sh**. They don’t carefully handle the luggage as their job require, they throw it and break it. I’ve seen it with my own eyes once when they were handling bags as I was switching to a connection flight. I only travel to Europe once a year and every single time my luggage is either missing or broken. Horrible, horrible, horrible.
reviews.author: Dee

reviews.title: I will NEVER choose Lufthansa again
reviews.text: Absolutely disgraceful airline. Continuous delays causing me to miss my connecting flights on both the way out and the return journey home. How can an airline get it so wrong. NEVER again will I use this airline.
reviews.author: Jody S

reviews.title: 10 hours of agony
reviews.text: It was the worst flight ever. Old plane, no entertainment working - it looked as if it was there on that sad screen, but pressing on it didn't change anything. Staff sour, rude, not smiling once. Chairs were so extremely low quality that 2 days later I'm still sore everywhere. I know long flights on economy class are never easy. But Lufthansa took it to a way new level of agony. Shame on you all. I can't comprehend how services like this are still on business and staff like that are even legal to interact with customers.
reviews.author: Cristina N

reviews.title: Unfair Service upon check in - Bullied by non English speaking clerk
reviews.text: I am writing to express my formal complaint regarding the treatment I received during my return flight from Poznan airport with Luftansa. I found the conduct of your staff to be highly disappointing and unprofessional. I kindly request your attention to the following incident: Upon check-in, it was discovered that my bag exceeded the weight limit by 1 kilogram, totaling 24 kilograms. Consequently, I was informed by a particularly rude Luftansa staff member that I would be charged an amount of PLN 222.91. I was not given the opportunity to remove any items from my bag nor was I provided with the option to check my luggage through to my final destination in South Africa. Instead, I was bluntly instructed to make the payment. Interestingly, my colleague, who was traveling on the same flight, stood next to me with an overweight bag weighing 25.5 kilograms, yet he was not subjected to any charges. When I raised this inconsistency with the staff member assisting me, his response was dismissive, stating that it was solely at the discretion of his colleague to impose charges. He then insisted that I contact my fellow traveler and ask him to pay for his excess baggage. Which I did not do. To exacerbate matters, when I requested to speak with a manager to address the issue, no one was willing to assist me in English. As someone who would frequently traveling with Luftansa, as arranged by my company, I expected better treatment and a fair resolution to this matter. Instead, I felt bullied and disheartened by the behavior of your employee. I insist on a refund of the amount unjustly taken from me without any consideration for a more amicable solution during my journey. This experience was my first encounter with Luftansa, and I must admit that I am deeply saddened by the level of service I received. I trust that you will investigate this incident thoroughly and take appropriate action to rectify the situation. I value the relationship my company has with Luftansa and hope that steps will be taken to prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future. I look forward to your prompt response and a satisfactory resolution to this matter.
reviews.author: Reta S

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: All aboard -> immediately after "boarding completed" announcement: delay at least 1 hour 10 minutes -> no off-load back to business lounge and no service onboard. Thank You Lufthansa! Once again "Deutsche Hospitality"
reviews.author: Timo R

reviews.title: Value and efficiency
reviews.text: Timely and effective service, dealt with check in very effectively no security delays cheerful and helpful check in staff and crew. Food offering ok not restaurant standard but dispensed with cheer and filling. For short trip similar value to budget airline with a little bit more panache.
reviews.author: Joseph M

reviews.title: Horrible flight
reviews.text: I don't normally write flight reviews, but this time I just had to as it was the worst flight I've ever had. Flew on Monday Frankfurt to Singapore on a 747-800 - which is a great plane but we must have had the worst seats - absolute total lemons. Firstly I had asked for a window seat - yes got it, however when I sat down, there was no window, just a large blank wall. This on its own would be okay however both mine and my traveller's entertainment screens failed to work - the crew did try to fix it, but couldn't. Then our seats (20A and 20B) failed to recline. My seat had the box in front of me, but it also had something behind so the seat just would not budge. If it couldn't get any worse on a 13 hour flight, with nothing to look out the window as there was none, and nothing to watch on the screen, the breakfast served on such a long flight was a horrible smelly sandwhich, a muesli bar and a yoghurt - just disgusting. I couldn't eat it as it looked awful and smelt worse. I've always raved about Lufthansa in the past, but would be very reluctant to fly with them at the moment, they need to get their act together and stop using Covid issues as an excuse for poor service. In comparison, our next flight from Singapore to Auckland on Singapore Airlines was much different - everything worked and we had two hot meal services - even though the flight was shorter than with Lufthansa.
reviews.author: Amanda B

reviews.title: If you are you from Latin America, don't expect to get compensation from Lufthansa.
reviews.text: It's been almost a year since Lufthansa cancelled our Madrid-Frankfurt-San José (Costa Rica) flight on Premium Economy and sent the 4 of us via Avianca's Economy (terrible service) without a proper compensation of 2400 EUR as states the EU Law. They sent me a payment advice saying they allegedly "wired" the money, but the bank won't accept the transfer until they provide proper proof in the international format MT103, which includes the unique payment reference number UETR. So in summary, if you have a Latin American Bank such as BAC Credomatic which requests this format, you will never see your money as they don't know what a MT103 format is, which is unbelievable coming from such a prestigious airline as this format is widely used throughout the world, so they are probably just trying for me to give up and save the money. - Alejandro Chacon Chacon
reviews.author: Alejandro Chacón

reviews.title: Online check-in not working
reviews.text: Travelling with a group of eight we were surprised to be asked to input everyone's details for the return flight. Why were these not retained from the outbound flight?! Then having input it all we got a data collection error. Tried with mobile phone, laptop and tablet and both website and app. Very frustrating and anxiety inducing. Checking in at the airport meant we got rubbish seats at the rear of the plane. Flights outbound and inbound both delayed. Seats uncomfortable with minimal legroom.
reviews.author: Sharon C

reviews.title: Lufthansa is cheapening up, cutting all service at cost of customers
reviews.text: I think they used to be a high-end airline but now I hear from others many similar stories that they are saving money through cutting corners that hurt. I started my flight at 1855 from Stockholm and had to pay for food Sthlm-Germany, then Germany-Johannesburg I got a small dinner sometime after midnight, with a very tiny breakfast of sweetend yoghurt and bread with cheese and weird oily vegetable tapenade on top of the cheese (why serve something so "alternative?" - people didn't seem to like it). I was starving on arrival when a cheery message informed me that my bag was not in Jo-burg with me... The booking system had suggested a flight with only a 1hr stopover in Frankfurt which was probably not enough to reload the bags, alternativeley the plane was too full so they just offloaded random bags. But we were a good group of people from different connections who had their bags still in Europe when we arrived in Johannesburg. They seemed to be hoping we would all file reports on where to deliver the bags online instead of taking up time from a real person but as I was still flying an internal flight the system couldn't handle it. Imagine if they had thought to offload the bags of people who were homebound to Joburg how much easier it would have been to deliver them and how much less hassle it had been for the people who just came home... If you are going to meetings or holidays its obviously mush worse not to have your bags on arrival. I landed Sunday afternoon in my final destination with an important Monday meeting and my clothing on the flight was very inappropriate for the meeting. With carry-on restrictions at 8 kg, the bag itself + laptop weighing 5 kg and all electronics, valuables and key papers needing to be in the carry on there is no chance to put better shoes or clothes in the carry on bag. Relaxing the rules and allowing at least 10 kg would be great... Hardly anything is open on Sunday evening, so I was struggling to get deodorant and toothpaste even. "We're sorry if it caused you any incovenience" as was written on the note, with no attempt at any kind of compensation felt like a slap in the face. Not offering even a stupid voucher as compensation for all the stress and time this consumed, not to mention looking bad at an important meeting carries its own message about how sorry they really are. The fact that there was no information about having the right to buy items or how to reclaim the money was infuriating too. Why are they not explaining that – just waiting for us to complain, hoping we won't so they can save some money? How cheap and low is that?? Finally there is no way of contacting Lufthansa or the courier company when the bag is not delivered swiftly as promised. It is obvious that they are NOT doing “everything we can to get it delivered as soon as possible”. It didn't arrived the whole of the next day, and I was going back to the airport to rent a car and drive onwards the third day. I'd like to contact the courier to stop them from sending the bag to my accommodation that I will have checked out of by the time it arrives, and just let me get the bag at the airport. But there is NO contact details, just a company name. Even when I google the company, there is no phone number. And Lufthansa sends automated emails that the bag will be delivered swiftly by the courier, emails they ask me not to reply to. I got 3 phone numbers on a paper to swissport luggage handling at Johannesburg airport, where nobody is answering. This is money-saving-automated-support from hell. My 76 year old mom had a similar experience with Lufthansa that comes to mind now, they had overbooked a flight and threw some people off, she had flewn from the States all night and was tired on arrival and just wanted to fly the final 2 hrs home to Sweden, instead she had to stand in a looong queue and they finally agreed to pay her a night of hotel after queueing and complaining for hours. If they overbook their plane so they have to th
reviews.author: Nontyatyambo

reviews.title: Beware of this airlines company, they are the WORST!
reviews.text: I swear if I could give them 0 stars I would, never in my life I’ve faced such a disappointment with every step in the way. We had a flight from Israel to Lisbon, with 1 stop in Frankfurt. Our flight got delayed, even though we had a connecting flight (also Lufthansa’s flight) and we had to spent the entire flight worrying if we will make it on time. We landed in almost two hours delay and ran like CRAZY at the airport just to get the next flight. They didn’t let us going to the plane with our trolly luggage, even though we explained them that we have a connecting flight right after and we have to run there, and that we really concerned that the luggage won’t come with us to the next flight. They reassured us that the luggage will be transfer with our next flight automatically. Guess what? IT DID NOT. Of course that this nightmare continues on to our luggage got lost and stayed at the connecting airport (Frankfurt). Just great. After all this horrible experience they lost our luggage??? Really? The next day they said that the luggage will be at the Lisbon airport at 11:15 AM. We only got a confirmation message at 15:00 PM. We came to the airport to pick it up and we had to wait in a 2 HOURS in the ground force boot just to get a clue where they placed our luggage. How about writing that in the e-mail? Need to reach Lufthansa’s service center? Wait for 45 MINUTES just to speak to a person in order to find out where to even go! Overall, the entire first day of our vacation was spent trying to find our luggage. Needless to say they didn’t offer any compensation.
reviews.author: MelanyBenjamin

reviews.title: Unable to check in online
reviews.text: With 22 hours to go we tried to check in online as advised. Unable to do so becuase we kept getting 'technical error - not specified' message. So tried the on line chat only to end up speaking to a useless BOT (AI that doesn't work). BOT tells me to call Lufthansa, it costs 40p/minute to do that! First time we have flown with Lufthansa and it will be the last if this is anything to go by!
reviews.author: David E

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Always delayed, rude and terrible customer service. Unfortunately the government keeps subsidizing it so they don't have to even strive to be competitive.
reviews.author: Marina R

reviews.title: Lufthansa Hell Hole
reviews.text: My family and I had an absolutely horrific experience with Lufthansa this past month. This all occurred on May 20, 2023 concerning a flight from Charlotte, NC to Munich, Germany. My cousin's birthdate was incorrect on her boarding pass, so when she tried to go through security, she was sent back to the help desk to get it fixed. Her boyfriend was traveling with us as well, and he went with her to the help desk. The agent at the desk fixed her boarding pass, and then she decided to go ahead and check the boyfriend's boarding pass as well to ensure everything was fine for both of them. The agent found a discrepancy between the boyfriend's name on his passport versus the name on his booking. The name on the booking was "Kiah," which is what we all call him on a daily basis, but his government name is "Hezekiah," and that's what is in his passport. One might think that this is an easy fix. The agent can just go in and correct his name to match his passport just like they changed my cousin's birthdate to match her actual birthdate. WRONG! My cousin, her boyfriend, and my uncle fought with a plethora of agents at the Lufthansa help desk for HOURS trying to get this simple problem fixed. They were met with hatred, confusion, dismissal, and every other form of ignorant customer service you can imagine. Meanwhile, the 4 other people in our party (including myself) were already waiting at our gate ready to board. And mind you, we're trying to get on our first flight that will eventually connect us to Athens, Greece for a wedding that we cannot miss. The worst possible thing that could've happened happened. After 3 straight hours of bickering with agents and trying to solve this seemingly simple issue, my uncle, cousin, and her boyfriend were forced by Lufthansa to stay back in Charlotte, NC and resolve the issue while the rest of us got on a plane to Munich, Germany. Our family was quite literally separated by the Atlantic Ocean, which, as I'm sure most can imagine, was very emotionally traumatizing in its own right, not to mention especially for my aunt who is disabled and whose daughter and husband (my uncle and cousin) were left behind. According to my uncle, cousin, and her boyfriend, they were on the phone for virtually 3 whole days trying to straighten out this issue. My uncle, who took the brunt of the disservice from Lufthansa, was told time and time again that he needed to check with United (whom Lufthansa is under) to fix the booking, but then when he called United, they told him to check with Lufthansa. So, it was a constant back and forth which would eventually lead him to no solutions and just more confusion and frustration. Agents gave him no information whatsoever, and when he asked to speak with their supervisors, it was claimed that they were all "busy." Yeah. Busy being unhelpful and awful. And, of course, since they were forced to stay in Charlotte, they had to stay in a hotel and buy food for which they were given no compensation or vouchers for. We also had flights with a different airline (called Sky Express, a flight from Athens to Santorini) that my uncle was forced to repurchase because of Lufthansa's mistakes. These are thousands of dollars that my uncle lost. This doesn't even get into the emotional damages that my cousin's boyfriend went through and felt. Looking back on this experience, it is quite obvious to us that there was a racial factor at play since he was the only person in our party who was black. If his passport photo and license photo matched (which they did), it's hard to see why a simple addition of "Heze-" on his boarding pass couldn't be made unless there was underlying discrimination occurring. I know wholeheartedly that if a man named "Johnathan" booked under the name "John," there would be no issues whatsoever. Not to mention how they treated Hezekiah like a child, constantly dismissing his concerns and talking down to him like he had no idea what he was talking about. Absolutely disgusting
reviews.author: Emily L

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Boarding of flight was not great - Group 3 was allowed to board before Group 2 was done !!??!. Plane was crowded - but that's typical for any airline. Upon arrival at midnight in Oslo, bags took forever to come. But ours was not there - had not made the transfer at Frankfurt. Seems like the airline has grown to be a bit more than the team can effectively manage. Its a day later, and multiple flights have come to Oslo, and we still don't have our bags.
reviews.author: Bob S

reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text: Prior to boarding we all had to lineup to do a document check. WHY should I have to do this if I have a CANADIAN PASSPORT? We then had to go back and sit down and do the lineup all over again to board. Common sense would be to check only those travelling with out a Canadian Passport. Total total mess.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.title: Nasty check-in in Munich
reviews.text: The check-in process in Munich to Tel Aviv is atrocious! You check-in in terminal F2 and then bused to the main terminal. If you are not in a wheelchair you have to walk up 4 floors with all your hand luggage! They don't even warn you in advance! This has been going on for several years, I know that LH can do better than that. It is a good airline.
reviews.author: David R

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Lost it touch and class , old seat and stings , a lot of debris between the chair and facade. Food lost if tast no class what so,ever I felt like I am bagging for service ,their lounge at EWR is over crowded and tiny not enough capacity also lounge food is far from decent . Handicap help not available upon arrival have to waite an hour almost lost my flight to cairo . Plane to cairo was made in early century, no business class but the seat next to me is empty. No room for ur legs or to move , sit still for 4 hours flight . Never again , my advice to the German Airlines to respect ur passengers and go back 15 years to your famous and great airline , respect the egyptian and has new plans with business seats to cairo . That said don't fly with the German.
reviews.author: AT EF

reviews.title: Worst airline hating it's clients
reviews.text: Flight on Sunday from Gdansk via FRA was delayed so i missed my connection to Madrid. And on Monday they had a strike. The flight that was delayed was on Sunday and that day there was no strike. No hotel offered, no nothing. Rebooked to Tuesday evening - so 2 nights in a hotel. And when i applied for a compensation that i am eligible to by law, they eventually declined as i was not agreeing to their terms. The client support is so incredibly arrogant, literally humiliating you in emails. Unbelievable, frankly speaking. Lufthansa doesn't care at all if you return or not.
reviews.author: Anna K

reviews.title: Worst airline in the entire world
reviews.text: The worst airline in the entire world. Food was inedible, airline attendants were cold and rude. They lost my luggage for 4 days, and no apology, plus they still haven't paid the inconvenience fee for replacement items I submitted. Good luck getting these guys on the phone to answer any questions. I was even scolded by a girl running the handicap assistance cart for getting on, and she told me to walk to the ticket counter to get handicap designation on my ticket, even though I had already done that. When she found out her error, she didn't even apologize. RUDE people from top to bottom!!! Do not Use!
reviews.author: Kenneth M

reviews.title: Stolen, delayed and hurt
reviews.text: #1 Lufthansa contracted carrier obliged us to pay for luggage we had already paid to lifthansa claiming that Lufthansa did not communicated them to their system #2 started flight delayed due to “technical problems” of the aircraft #3 obliged us to dispatch hand luggage at the gate which we found at arrival has been stolen #4 international flight has no room for changing toddlers nor any facility to lay them temporarily nor permanently throughout the flight. Disgraceful
reviews.author: Tiago S

reviews.title: Trash airplane, trash service, trash airline
reviews.text: We paid over 5k for business class tickets to Milan and were told the morning of our trip that they went with a smaller plane and we no longer had business class seats. We could fly economy and go thru a process to try and get a refund, or we could fly thru American Airlines, have a 5 hour layover and fly thru a different airport. Not a great start. We chose the longer layover, because we really had no other choice. The "first class" leg from Frankfurt to Milan was a sham. Trash plane, trash first class and the worst food we've ever had on a plane. Inedible. Oh and the stewardesses were fairly rude. Flight home was on time, but the boarding process was horrible, and again, the food was atrocious. This is the first time I've every used Lufthansa, and it will be the last. I would rather fly anywhere else and drive.
reviews.author: Jeff K

reviews.title: Worst flight experience
reviews.text: I have been to over 75 countries, so obviously I am no stranger to flights. Hands down, this Lufthansa flight was the worst I've experienced. The seats were narrow (and I'm a size 8 and not tall), the food inedible, and the service sparse. I will go out of the way to avoid this airline in the future.
reviews.author: Susan H

reviews.title: They don't care about their customers
reviews.text: I booked my flight on line, and filled out the online profile. In the profile I was requiried to select a salutation (Mr) and an educational title (Dr). The ticket attached the Mr and Dr to the end of my first name, which did not match my passport, I was therefore denied borading. The ticketing agents could not change it and were extremaly rude. The phone agent told me it woud take several days to change it. Luthansa refueses to refund any of the lost money or even give me a credit towad a new flight. I have been fighting with them to no avail for 3 months now, including contacting the US Executive VP, Carsten Spohr. As far as I am concerned, Lufthansa has the worst possible customer service and is flat dishonest.
reviews.author: Richard F

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: Flight LH691: Early morning flight. Surprisingly uncomfortable seats (not reclinable - 19E, 19F), for breakfast was sandwich with chease with a dry rye bread.relatively Flight LH860: was a relatively old aircraft, but the flight was very smooth and the seats were more comfotable.
reviews.author: Mark Snir

reviews.title: I'm traumatized
reviews.text: 10pm connecting flight canceled, those who don't need visas are escorted to hotels and warm meals. We sleep in the open corridor in the airport, men women children. I'm only in transit from the US but the differential treatment is mentally agonizing
reviews.author: Lillian D

reviews.title: LUFTHANSA WEBSITE SUCKS - CANT BOOK BAGGAGE ONLINE
reviews.text: LUFTHANSA website was extremely slow and would not load, therefore will need to pay for baggage fee at the counter for a higher fee than normal. Website is extremely poor designed.
reviews.author: justin s

reviews.title: Worst travel experience in the hundreds of flights taken.  And Zero customer service.
reviews.text: If there was anything Lufthansa could mess up on our recent international trip, they did. And they have ZERO customer service and no ability to troubleshoot -- not what I expected of a German airline. First, they canceled flights for the six of us (no reason - so presumably lack of staff). It took a lot of effort (and money on hotels, food) to get flights rescheduled, and each time Lufthansa said they would email new confirmations. They never did. Still haven't. Called back 8 times. Even at the airport gate, they still couldn't figure it out. Then of course they lost our luggage. They still can't find some of it, even though the air tag confirms they still have it in Frankfurt. No one at Lufthansa U.S. has a means to contact Frankfurt baggage claim, and their online baggage report claims the luggage is both out for delivery and not yet located. They couldn't explain which is correct. And I know at least two are still in Frankfurt. The call agent simply said it could take days, weeks, or months -- and we just have to wait and see. This is grossly unacceptable. And we were business class, international customers. What is most striking is the lack of intelligence, and inability to communicate within the company and to the customer. I will forever avoid Lufthansa. Bottom line is they appear to me to be grossly incompetent, and their behavior communicates that they really don't care about their customers.
reviews.author: DFW Passenger

reviews.title: Check in is a joke !?!
reviews.text: Been waiting over 20minutes and still no one checked in as check in staff too busy chatting with themselves instead of working. Absolute joke.
reviews.author: Kevin Clarke

reviews.title: No comment
reviews.text: They leave you stranded for 24 hours, offer you an alternative with a 5-hour stopover, and give you a ticket for dinner in a restaurant at the Innsbruck airport. Flight 1146 June 11.
reviews.author: Fernando S

reviews.title: Worst experience of my life
reviews.text: Flight LH590 from frankfurt to kenya was the worst experience of my life. A male flight attendant was one of the rudest individuals I've encountered in my life if you are so unhappy serving blacks maybe stick with european flights. He was yelling at passengers that had their carryon bags wrongly placed then slamming the compartment doors. Had the snarkiest look on his face the whole flight clearly miserable and didn't want to be there. He went on to deny me service all through the flight because I dared request a dinner which by the way i paid for. He pointed to another attendant while he gave me the nastiest look. He continued to ignore me for the rest of the flight even when serving my aisle. I should have listened to the kenyan official who had the bad experience on a lufthansa flight to Germany. Why add more flights to kenya then treat the citizens like garbage. Kenyans beware avoid lufthansa at all costs. And all the shuttle busses jam packed and very unprofessional staff that couldn't explain where to go at the airport or completely ignored you right to your face when you asked for help. TRAIN YOUR INCOMPETENT STAFF!!!!!
reviews.author: Ange W

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: I had to rebook my return flight from WRO to SFO , as permitted with my premium economy ticket, but could not do so online so I called the customer service hotline. They said they rebooked the ticket and that I should get a confirmation email in 24 hours and if no email to call back. I have called this customer service number several times in the past 3 days and each time either the call drops, the agents say "call us in 24 hours if you don't get the confirmation email". Multiple agents have "sent" the email, I've provided multiple addresses, and still no email. I have been trying to get this sorted since May 8th and its June 11. This is ridiculous, I am not asking for a lot just a confirmation email as I was told I would be getting to confirm the changes. I given the run around by rude agents. I will never book with Lufthansa again due to their rude and unprofessional customer service.I have finally tried to use the livechat and got a ton of attitude, despite having explained why I am frustrated after multiple hours on their hotline. See photos of conversation with agent below:
reviews.author: Natalie

reviews.title: Doesn’t feel like business class at all
reviews.text: With most airlines, business class service is much closer to First class which makes sense because the cost is closer to first class than economy. In the case of Lufthansa , however, the cost may be closer to First but the service and amenity’s are much closer to premium economy. How can they justify a one way ticket to Oslo from New York costing $6000 but still charging $25 for WiFi ? Who does that? And the food is god awful. The seats are cramped, My crappy little bag didn’t even have a sleep mask and I had to ask for one. The folks in first class, though, are rocking it. So, here’s my lesson: If I ever get stuck flying Lufthansa again Im either going to pony up for the first class or save oodles of cash and fly economy. Because the business class just is not worth it.
reviews.author: Sarah R

reviews.title: Worst airways and customer care
reviews.text: Earlier on 3rd june customer care center told me they will charge 23 euro for flight cancellation from vienna to Frankfurt and refund 43 euro, and on 7th june some other customer care executive called and blackmailed that charges are not applicable and she will charge 82.56 euro for cancellation, if not accepted she will cancel booking and connection to bangalore will not be allowed to board, too arrogant and don't know why should I be paying for additional fee for cancelling 1 connecting flight, worst service encountered, even service in flight is not upto mark, very bad airline
reviews.author: Sandeep

reviews.title: Avoid this airline if you have Valuable Luggage
reviews.text: I am extremely disappointed with the abysmal service I have received from Lufthansa regarding my lost baggage. It has been an absolute nightmare trying to get any assistance or resolution since January 2023. This level of negligence and incompetence is simply unacceptable! "Lufthansa, your customer service is a complete joke! How can it take months to handle a lost baggage case? I have been left in the dark with no updates or proper communication. This is a clear reflection of your disregard for your passengers and their belongings." "I regret ever choosing Lufthansa! Their inability to handle a simple lost baggage case is mind-boggling. It's been months of frustration and inconvenience, and there seems to be no end in sight. Your lack of accountability and failure to provide a satisfactory resolution is utterly disappointing." "Lufthansa, you have shattered my faith in your airline with your horrendous service. The way you have mishandled my lost baggage case since January 2023 is an absolute disgrace. Your lack of urgency and empathy towards your customers is appalling. It's time to step up and take responsibility for your mistakes!"
reviews.author: Ihab H
